verses.gurmukhi: ਉਲਟਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨ ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਸੰਗਮ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਥਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aulaT pavan man meen kee chapal gat sukhamanaa sa(n)gam kai braham sathaan hai ||

en.bdb: The unsettled wind and fickle-fish of the mind is contained within the mind of the God-conscious being.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰ ਸਲਿਲ ਗਹਿ ਗਗਨ ਘਟਾ ਘਮੰਡ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਲਗਨ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saagar salil geh gagan ghaTaa ghama(n)dd unaman magan lagan gur giaan hai ||

en.bdb: They merge with the Eternal Light of the Lord, just as the river merges with the water of the ocean. They remain in ecstacy and are focused, devoted on lighting their spirit with the Light the Guru has shone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਮੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਸਰੂਪ ਦਾਮਿਨੀ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਗਰਜਤ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jot mai jotee saroop dhaaminee chamatakaar garajat anahadh sabadh neesaan hai ||

en.bdb: By melding into the super radiance of the Lord, they enjoy the blissful electric radiance of the union. They hear the sound of unstruck music loud and clear.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਬਰਖਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਕਲ ਫਲ ਸਰਬ ਨੀਧਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੯॥
verses.translit_en: nijhar apaar dhaar barakhaa a(n)mirat jal sevak sakal fal sarab needhaan hai ||59||

en.bdb: They perpetually enjoy the continuous flow of the divine elixir in the Dasam Duar and the seekers obtain all the fruits and treasures. (59)
